description: Seven fixed synthetic before cases for the unchanged comply and permanent-defiance roots. Actor GER, host/event target ETH, date 1936.1.1. The global public Strength values and GER Wrath values are explicit; the same valid active light recognition demand and neutral non-war/non-faction context are held constant. The 60-point case probes the source dominant-trigger boundary. No helper booleans or candidateOverrides are supplied. This fixture is not a live campaign, a world-state census, or a complete all-decisions selection pool.
